defects.defect: FLS is granted to the Slack integration and Data Cloud connector permission sets only because they have FLS on Image_URL__c. Nobody asked for integration exposure, so this widens the scope a little. It is labelled and discussed in Sections 5, 6 and 8, but it is not raised as an open decision on whether integration users should get the field at all.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: SKILL.md has no guidance on whether to copy FLS from a sibling field to integration or connector permission sets, or to limit grants to human-user permission sets by default.

defects.defect: Layout placement ('same section as Image_URL__c') is an assumption because the layout section structure was never retrieved. It is labelled as non-blocking in Section 8, but it could have been checked read-only.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: spec-format does not require layout section evidence for a layout Update.

defects.defect: run.json does not record the order of the user question and the first AskCoworker call, so 'ask before AskCoworker' can only be inferred from the spec's wording ('too vague to search, so the user was asked'). Every AskCoworker call also shows seconds=0, so the timing data looks uninstrumented.
defects.skill_gap: RUNNER/run.json schema: there is no timestamp or sequence field for user_questions relative to askcoworker_calls.

defects.defect: Run-reported friction: it is unclear whether a retry of a timed-out follow-up counts toward the 3-follow-up limit, and nothing covers an incomplete response that ends in 'Would you like me to proceed?'.
defects.skill_gap: The SKILL.md response-handling table has no row for an incomplete response that ends with a permission question, and no retry-accounting rule for follow-ups.
